description: Corrected baseline: department+domain as separate concepts. 6 concepts (dept, workspace, collection, asset, permission, domain-as-infrastructure). Contradiction: release UI shows own domain.
Filter own domain from release pills. Eliminates the self-release contradiction.
Reframe domain as release audiences. User sees "Marketing" not "MARKETING domain." 5 concepts.
Explicit department-to-domain mapping. Not every dept releases; some only share via collections.
Department membership: seeded from CAM onboarding, managed in-app by coordinators. Resolves Julie alarm.
